```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Create VST RNA-seq matrix from HTSeq count files
## Input  : HTSeq *.txt files
## raw HTSeq counts → gene symbols → low-expression filter → VST → top variable genes after VST
## Output : VST matrices for MOFA2 / WGCNA / clustering
############################################################

set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(biomaRt)
  library(dplyr)
})

############################################################
## Define input and output directories
############################################################

count_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC"

out_dir <- file.path(count_dir, "VST_data")

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Input HTSeq count directory:\n", count_dir, "\n\n")
cat("Output directory:\n", out_dir, "\n\n")

############################################################
## Read all HTSeq count files
############################################################

count_files <- list.files(
  count_dir,
  pattern = "\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(count_files) == 0) {
  stop("No .txt HTSeq count files found in: ", count_dir)
}

cat("Found", length(count_files), "HTSeq count files.\n\n")

read_htseq_file <- function(file) {
  
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  
  df <- read.table(
    file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = "\t",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    col.names = c("ensembl_id", sample_name)
  )
  
  return(df)
}

count_list <- lapply(count_files, read_htseq_file)

counts_df <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "ensembl_id", all = TRUE),
  count_list
)

counts_df[is.na(counts_df)] <- 0

cat("Merged HTSeq count matrix dimensions:\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(counts_df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(counts_df), "\n\n")

############################################################
## Remove HTSeq summary rows
## Example rows: __no_feature, __ambiguous, __too_low_aQual
############################################################

counts_df <- counts_df[!grepl("^__", counts_df$ensembl_id), ]

cat("After removing HTSeq summary rows:\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(counts_df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(counts_df), "\n\n")

############################################################
## Remove Ensembl version numbers
## Example: ENSG00000141510.18 -> ENSG00000141510
############################################################

counts_df$ensembl_id_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", counts_df$ensembl_id)

############################################################
## Map Ensembl IDs to HGNC gene symbols
############################################################

cat("Mapping Ensembl IDs to HGNC gene symbols using biomaRt...\n")

mart <- useMart(
  biomart = "ensembl",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"
)

gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = unique(counts_df$ensembl_id_clean),
  mart = mart
)

gene_map <- gene_map %>%
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Mapped", nrow(gene_map), "Ensembl IDs to HGNC symbols.\n\n")

############################################################
## Merge gene symbols with count matrix
############################################################

out_df <- merge(
  counts_df,
  gene_map,
  by.x = "ensembl_id_clean",
  by.y = "ensembl_gene_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

out_df$gene_name <- ifelse(
  out_df$hgnc_symbol == "" | is.na(out_df$hgnc_symbol),
  out_df$ensembl_id_clean,
  out_df$hgnc_symbol
)
```


```{r}
############################################################
## Prepare count matrix and collapse duplicate gene symbols
############################################################

sample_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(out_df),
  c("ensembl_id_clean", "ensembl_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_name")
)

count_mat_symbol <- out_df[, c("gene_name", sample_cols)]

count_mat_symbol[, sample_cols] <- lapply(
  count_mat_symbol[, sample_cols],
  as.numeric
)

count_mat_symbol <- count_mat_symbol %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

count_mat_symbol <- as.data.frame(count_mat_symbol)

rownames(count_mat_symbol) <- count_mat_symbol$gene_name
count_mat_symbol$gene_name <- NULL

cat("After collapsing duplicate gene symbols:\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(count_mat_symbol), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(count_mat_symbol), "\n\n")

############################################################
## Save raw count matrix with gene names
############################################################

raw_out <- cbind(
  Gene = rownames(count_mat_symbol),
  count_mat_symbol
)

write.csv(
  raw_out,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


```{r}
############################################################
## Low-expression filtering before VST
############################################################

cat("Filtering low-expressed genes before VST...\n")

min_samples <- ceiling(ncol(count_mat_symbol) * 0.10)
min_count <- 5

cat("Minimum count cutoff:", min_count, "\n")
cat("Gene must have count >=", min_count, "in at least", min_samples, "samples.\n")

keep_genes <- rowSums(count_mat_symbol >= min_count) >= min_samples

counts_filtered <- count_mat_symbol[keep_genes, ]

cat("After low-expression filtering:\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(counts_filtered), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(counts_filtered), "\n\n")

filtered_out <- cbind(
  Gene = rownames(counts_filtered),
  counts_filtered
)

write.csv(
  filtered_out,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_expression_filtered_counts_gene_names.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


```{r}
############################################################
## DESeq2 VST transformation
############################################################

cat("Running DESeq2 VST transformation...\n")

counts_filtered <- round(as.matrix(counts_filtered))

storage.mode(counts_filtered) <- "integer"

coldata <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(counts_filtered)
)

rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filtered,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ 1
)

vst_obj <- tryCatch(
  {
    vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    cat("vst() gave an error. Trying varianceStabilizingTransformation() instead.\n")
    cat("Original error message:\n")
    cat(e$message, "\n")
    
    varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = TRUE)
  }
)

vst_mat <- assay(vst_obj)

cat("VST matrix dimensions:\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(vst_mat), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(vst_mat), "\n\n")
```


```{r}
############################################################
## Save full VST matrix
############################################################

vst_out <- cbind(
  Gene = rownames(vst_mat),
  as.data.frame(vst_mat)
)

write.csv(
  vst_out,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_gene_names_all_expression_filtered_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  vst_obj,
  file.path(out_dir, "DESeq2_VST_object.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  vst_mat,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_matrix_all_expression_filtered_genes.rds")
)

############################################################
## Select top variable genes after VST
############################################################

cat("Selecting top variable genes after VST...\n")

top_n_genes <- 5000

vst_gene_vars <- apply(vst_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

top_variable_genes <- names(
  sort(vst_gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:min(top_n_genes, length(vst_gene_vars))]

vst_mat_topvar <- vst_mat[top_variable_genes, ]

cat("Top-variable VST matrix dimensions:\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(vst_mat_topvar), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(vst_mat_topvar), "\n\n")
```


```{r}
############################################################
## Save top-variable VST matrix
############################################################

vst_topvar_out <- cbind(
  Gene = rownames(vst_mat_topvar),
  as.data.frame(vst_mat_topvar)
)

write.csv(
  vst_topvar_out,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_gene_names_top5000_variable_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  vst_mat_topvar,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_matrix_top5000_variable_genes.rds")
)

############################################################
## Save gene variance table
############################################################

gene_variance_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(vst_gene_vars),
  VST_variance = as.numeric(vst_gene_vars)
)

gene_variance_df <- gene_variance_df[order(gene_variance_df$VST_variance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(
  gene_variance_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_gene_variance_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
## Save sample names
############################################################

sample_info <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(vst_mat)
)

write.csv(
  sample_info,
  file.path(out_dir, "VST_sample_names.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


```{r}
############################################################
## Final summary
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("DONE: VST RNA-seq matrix generated successfully\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("Output folder:\n")
cat(out_dir, "\n\n")

cat("Raw count matrix:\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.rds"), "\n\n")

cat("Expression-filtered count matrix:\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "htseq_expression_filtered_counts_gene_names.rds"), "\n\n")

cat("Full VST matrix:\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_matrix_all_expression_filtered_genes.rds"), "\n\n")

cat("Recommended RNA matrix for MOFA2:\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_matrix_top5000_variable_genes.rds"), "\n\n")

cat("CSV version for checking:\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "htseq_VST_gene_names_top5000_variable_genes.csv"), "\n")


cat("Summary:\n")
cat("Original rows after removing HTSeq summary rows:", nrow(counts_df), "\n")
cat("Unique genes after symbol collapsing:", nrow(count_mat_symbol), "\n")
cat("Genes after low-expression filtering:", nrow(counts_filtered), "\n")
cat("Genes in full VST matrix:", nrow(vst_mat), "\n")
cat("Genes in top-variable VST matrix:", nrow(vst_mat_topvar), "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", ncol(vst_mat), "\n")
```
